questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which one among the following is an antioxidant?
questions.solution:
Antioxidants are substances that may protect
our cells, against the effects of free radicals. These are good reducing agent and are capable to produce free radicals to protect us from the effects of free radicals.
Among the given options, only option (b) BHT (butylated hydroxy toluene) is a good reducing agent and can provide free radical.
Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.
